boundary.description: From the point where Rochdale – Manchester District boundary meets Wince Brook, E along the Wince Brook to the point opposite Greenson Drive on River Irk, by a bee-line to Hall Driver, Alkrington Hall Road North, Manchester New Road (A664), E along Mount Road, and along Round Thorn Road in a straight line to and S along Wince Brook to and S along Rochdale – Oldham District boundary and then Rochdale – Manchester District boundary to where it meets Wince Brook.
